headline: Anthropic is reportedly set to show institutional investors its third-quarter financial results for the first time, at a meeting on 14 October ahead of a possible share listing.
score_reason: Pool score kept: first financial disclosure by one of the biggest AI labs before a possible listing, but it rests on two unnamed people and the figures are not public.
importance_line: People weighing whether to buy into an Anthropic listing, and the investors who price AI companies across the sector, are waiting on figures that nobody outside the company has seen, so the report shows a listing is being prepared, not that it is certain.
summary: CNBC reports, citing two people familiar with the matter, that Anthropic, the maker of the Claude AI models, will show its third-quarter financial results to institutional investors (large funds that buy shares in bulk) for the first time at a meeting on Wednesday 14 October; Anthropic declined to comment, and Bloomberg had earlier reported that it was preparing a pre-IPO investor day. The figures could show how fast the company is growing and whether it makes a profit, which matters because azat.tv, citing Reuters, says a stock-market listing is targeted for November, although no debut date is confirmed and the results themselves have not been published.
notes: CNBC page blocked (HTTP 403); text read in TradingKey and azat.tv relays of the CNBC story. Headline of the CNBC report is not copied. Unattributed azat.tv figures left out.
